CONTEXT (my identification). Gauss uses his theta series P(x)=1+2Σx^{n^2}, Q(x)=1+2Σ(-1)^n x^{n^2} (and R(x)=2x^{1/4}Σx^{n(n+1)}), with x=e^{-πt}. The parameter is t0=(1+22i)/97=(1+2i)/(9-4i), i.e. the 'summatorische Functionen von (1+22i)/97' of the previous page. P_n, Q_n denote P(x^n), Q(x^n)=P(n t0), Q(n t0). The previous page summed the slowly convergent series (|x|≈0.968) and obtained P16, Q16, P64, Q64; this page cross-checks them.

TOP TABLE. Each row gives, where filled in: (a) the complex value; (b) log10 modulus (10-shifted logs) and argument in d.m.s.; (c) the same for the square, i.e. doubled log and doubled argument; (d) the square in rectangular form.

(1) Rows P1, Q1, P2, Q2. Only (c) is filled. All arguments are -23°57'46'' = arg(9-4i), or 156°2'14'' = that plus 180°. Reconstruction (mine): from t→t+2i (x unchanged), t→t+i (x→-x, P↔Q) and t→1/t (P(1/t)^2=tP(t)^2, Q(1/t)^2=tR(t)^2) one gets
- P(t0)^2=(9-4i)P(e^{-π})^2;
- Q(t0)^2=(9-4i)Q(e^{-π})^2;
- P(2t0)^2=(9-4i)P(e^{-2π})^2;
- Q(2t0)^2=-(9-4i)Q(e^{-2π})^2.
Checks: log|Q1^2|=log√97+log 0.83462=0.91489 (written 0.91487). log|P2^2|=0.99340+log(1+2e^{-2π})^2=0.99662 ✓. log|Q2^2|=0.99013 ✓.

(2) Row 4.
- P4=0.26532-0.05630i: log|P4|=9.43335, arg -11°58'53''. P4^2: 8.86670, -23°57'46'' = 0.06723-0.02988i.
- Q4=2.63141+1.71004i: 0.49667, 33°1'7''. Q4^2=3.99997+8.99994i ≈ 4+9i.
- Exact (mine): Q(4t0)^2=(4+9i)Q(e^{-4π})^2 = 3.99994+8.99987i. P(4t0)^2=(9-4i)R(e^{-4π})^2 = (9-4i)·0.0074698 = 0.067228-0.029879i.

(3) Duplication (theta/AGM) step: P(x^2)^2=(P^2+Q^2)/2, Q(x^2)^2=PQ.
- P8^2=(P4^2+Q4^2)/2=2.03360+4.48503i (log 0.69236, arg 65°36'33'').
- Q8^2=P4·Q4=0.79444+0.30556i (log 9.93002, arg 21°2'14'').
- P16^2=(P8^2+Q8^2)/2=1.41406+2.39522i.
- Q16^2=P8·Q8: log 0.31120, arg -136°40'36''. This is (65°36'33''+21°2'14'')/2+180°, i.e. the NON-principal square-root branch is taken. Gauss checks both against the series values P16=1.44837+0.82689i (0.22214, 29°43'19'') and Q16=0.52817-1.32982i (0.15560, -68°20'18'') from the previous page.
- P32^2=(P16^2+Q16^2)/2=-0.03753+0.49524i (9.69606, 94°20'1'').
- Q32^2=P16·Q16 (0.37774, -38°36'59'')=1.86457-1.48937i.
- P64=0.98827-0.25147i (0.00849, -14°16'35''), P64^2=0.91340-0.49700i. Q64=1.01271+0.25127i (0.01846, 13°56'4''), Q64^2=0.96245+0.50892i. These are compared with (P32^2+Q32^2)/2 and P32·Q32.
- Last line: P128^2=(P64^2+Q64^2)/2=0.93792+0.00596i.
So the page is a consistency check of the directly summed theta values against the complex AGM/Landen recursion with branch choices, starting from the near-exact values at n=4.

(4) 'Die einfachsten Canones'. For n=2^k Gauss lists reduced ('simplest') representatives of n·t, reduced modulo 2i (and inversions), with t equivalent to 1:
- 2: (2+8i)/17=2/(1-4i)
- 4: (4+16i)/17=4/(1-4i)
- 8: 8(1+4i)/17-2i=(8-2i)/17=2/(4+i)
- 16: 16(1+18i)/65-4i=(16+28i)/65=4/(4-7i)
- 32: 32(1+22i)/97-8i=(32-72i)/97, and +i gives (32+25i)/97=17/(32-25i)
- 64: 64(1+22i)/97-14i=(64+50i)/97=34/(32-25i)
The right-hand column gives the base t used: (1+4i)/17=1/(1-4i) for n=2,4,8; (1+18i)/65=(1-2i)/(-7-4i) for 16; (1+22i)/97=(1+2i)/(9-4i) for 32 and 64. All three are equivalent to t=1, e.g. 1/t0=(1-22i)/5 → shift 4i → (1-2i)/5 → invert → 1+2i → shift → 1.

(5) Stated criterion: a simplest canon always has Im t in [-1,1] and Im(1/t) in [-2,2]. In τ=it this is |Re τ|≤1, |Re(-1/τ)|≤2. That is the standard fundamental domain of the group generated by τ→τ+2 and τ→τ/(4τ+1) (a conjugate of Γ(2)). This is exactly the group preserving P^2 and Q^2 up to the automorphy factor. All listed canons satisfy it; n=2 lies on the boundary, Im(1/t)=-2.

(6) Side scratch: '32 - 4/(7+4i)', '(4+i)/(4-9i)=(7+40i)/97', '1/((4+4i)/(9+4i))', '(-1+4i)/(4+9i)=(32+25i)/97'. These are searches for the representation of the 32-canon; only the last identity is clearly meaningful.
errors: Q16^2 real part is written -1.48913; from Q16=0.52817-1.32982i (or from Gauss's own polar data 0.31120, -136°40'36'') it is -1.48946. The slip propagates to P32^2 (real part should be about -0.0377, not -0.03753). It explains the small mismatches below.

P64^2 written 0.91340-0.49700i matches direct squaring of P64 (0.91344-0.49704i) but not (P32^2+Q32^2)/2 computed with the slipped value (0.91352-0.49707i). With the corrected -1.48946 the AGM gives 0.91344, which agrees.
Q64^2 argument: P32·Q32 with the slipped P32 gives 27°51'31'' against the direct 27°52'8''. With the corrected P32^2 one gets about 27°52'6''. So the discrepancy is again due to the Q16^2 slip.

Canon for 32 written (32+72i)/97 (as transcribed). 32·(1+22i)/97 reduces mod 2i to (32-72i)/97. The stated equality to 17/(32-25i)=(32+25i)/97 holds only after an additional shift by i, which swaps P and Q. Either a sign slip or a misreading.
Right column '(1+2i)/(-7-4i)' does not equal (1+18i)/65; (1-2i)/(-7-4i) does. Probably a sign slip or misreading.
P1 log-modulus entry is illegible or overwritten. The theoretical value is log|(9-4i)P(e^{-π})^2|=1.06541, which does not obviously match what is visible.
